decisions: Travel with the yaw-coupled side camera vertical at 400 mm, radius 180 mm and range 100 to 400 mm; provisional geometry recorded in vehicle_dimensions.json.
Use an optically registered CAD silhouette across two observation poses for black material on light station paper. Preserve the original rejects and failed run.
risks: Synthetic positions, pinhole lens, grasp/placement receipts and assumed friction exclude real actuation error. The same layout and task code are reused in both successful runs.
next_steps: Replace virtual TCP with measured geometry and evaluate the existing interfaces under measured camera, actuation and lighting when acceptance resumes.
